lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr16V4Pt4 (reduced formula Cr4V(Pt)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 139), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two main environments: Cr centers with 14 geometric neighbors (4 Cr, 3 Pt, 7 V) and Cr centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. V and Pt each show 10-neighbor environments, and the periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cr 12-vertex polyhedra and among Cr 14-vertex polyhedra.
